name: boardgame-creator
title_zh: 从灵感草稿到朋友试玩，一张桌游的完整出生证明
tagline_zh: 点子有了，卡在「到底好不好玩」。它先把 6–10 个关键决策一次交底，再逼出一份今天就能手写出来的纸面原型。
tagline_en: You have the idea and you are stuck on whether it actually plays. This states the six to ten decisions that matter up front, then drives you to a paper prototype you could hand-write today.
desc_en: 中文实体桌游创作 Skill：从灵感、纸面原型到试玩迭代与朋友介绍材料
why_zh: 它给自己上了禁令：没经过真人试玩只能说「可试玩」，不能说「平衡」——纸面审查只找风险，不发合格证。
why_en: It bans itself from certain words: with no real playtest it may only say "playable", never "balanced". Paper review finds risks; it does not issue a pass.
limit_zh: 平衡只能靠真人试玩验，所以你得自己凑齐人——它明写纸面审查不能证明平衡。交付物是纸面原型，美术、量产、众筹一概不管，第一版明说不追求出版。多视角批评里连「易感到被针对者」都算上了，但那仍是模拟，不是玩家。不做电子游戏实现。
limit_en: Balance can only be proven at a real table, so you have to find the players yourself; the file says outright that paper review cannot prove balance. What you get is a paper prototype — art, manufacturing and crowdfunding are all out, and the first version deliberately does not aim at publication. Its multi-perspective critique even includes the player who feels picked on, but that is still simulation, not a playtester. No digital implementation.
title_en: A board game's full birth certificate, from spark to.
